result.stdout:
outwit-resolve — fetch and stage controller data assets per manifest.

Usage:
  outwit-resolve --manifest <path> [--manifest <path> ...] --output <dir> [options]

Required:
  --manifest <path>     Path to a controller.json manifest. May be specified multiple times.
  --output <dir>        Root directory where <name>.module/ subdirectories will be written.

Options:
  --platforms <list>    Comma-separated runtime identifiers to resolve assets for.
                        Default: the current machine's RID.
                        Example: --platforms win-x64,linux-x64,osx-arm64
  --cache <dir>         Override the asset cache root.
                        Default: ~/.outwit/asset-cache/
  -h, --help            Show this help.

Exit codes:
  0   success
  1   fetch / verify / extract failure
  2   invalid command-line arguments
